notes: WLC.EXO.37.8.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; the fallback is among the readings the ASV permits, so rule 53 has no consequence here.

min ha-kapporeth is rendered by the single fixed expression of one piece with, of which no morpheme owns a part, so rule 30 keeps it one unit headed on piece; the same treatment recurs in vv. 17, 21, 22, 25.
mi-zeh fuses into the determiners one and other (rule 30), the anarthrous qatsah taking the supplied the.
